title: how good is the aixun T3A/T3B? product review.
description:
@InjuredGadgets was kind enough to let us try one of their latest products, the aixun T3A (https://www.injuredgadgets.com/aixun-t3a-smart-soldering-station-w-t245-handle/). what is my honest opinion? I like it and definitely would use it! find out why in this video. also I do recommend the T3B model due to the difference in the iron holder.
